subject: Literature
title: The Mahabharata and Cosmic War
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Mahabharata and Cosmic War.

hook.text: The Mahabharata is the longest poem ever written, over one hundred thousand verses about a family at war.

buildup.text: The epic follows two sets of royal cousins whose rivalry escalates into a catastrophic eighteen-day battle.

discovery.text: The Bhagavad Gita, embedded within it, is a dialogue about duty, morality, and the nature of existence.

twist.text: The victors discover that winning the war destroyed nearly everything they fought for in the first place.

climax.text: The Mahabharata claims that whatever exists in the world is found within its verses, and what is not, exists nowhere.

punchline.text: The longest poem ever written said it contained everything.

quiz.question: What is the Bhagavad Gita's relationship to the Mahabharata?
options: It is a separate, unrelated text
It is a philosophical dialogue embedded within the Mahabharata
It is a later sequel to the Mahabharata
